{{Quote|We've learned the Empire has a cloaking device prototype at one of Balmorra's advanced weapon factories. It's the same technology hiding the Emperor's fortress.|[[Warren Sedoru]]|<ref name="TOR:LitB" />}}
During the early days of the [[Galactic War]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] undertook a '''mission''' to the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|contested]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] in order to retrieve a [[prototype cloaking device]]. Working with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Warren Sedoru]], [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Finley]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Fifth Expeditionary Force]], and the [[Balmorran resistance]], the Hero and crew tracked the prototype across the planet and finally located it in the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]]. The prototype was needed by a [[Jedi strike team (capture of the Sith Emperor)|Jedi strike team]] being formed by Jedi Master [[Tol Braga]] with the purpose of capturing the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] and a joint mission by the Hero and the medic [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Doc]] successfully retrieved the prototype from the factory.
